release_notes: Security Center 8-state detection: every required component (firewalld, fail2ban, ModSecurity+OWASP CRS, YARA, ClamAV, Trivy, OSV, Lynis, AIDE, rkhunter, chkrootkit, testssl, Logwatch, GoAccess, log watchdog, SpamAssassin, OpenDKIM, Apache, Nginx, Icecast, SHOUTcast v1/v2) reports missing/installed/configured/running/healthy/update/failed/not-detected with reliable binary+service+config probes. New installer modules 16-web-server/17-streaming/18-mail-security. Installer (RHEL) now installs Postfix+Dovecot (Maildir) + SHOUTcast. Fixed live mail delivery (home_mailbox Maildir + Dovecot mail_location). Webmail menu port fixed to 2096. /api/version exposes update state so the dashboard alert banner works. Updater install button uses unquoted sudo path (matches sudoers NOPASSWD). Setup wizard validates required components.
